title: Club Storage Charge on Moved Northgate Delivery & Installation Appointments
content:
A storage charge is added to the reschedule fee of each move that owes a fee on a Northgate Delivery & Installation appointment, according to the calendar days from the appointment's booking date to its currently booked delivery date. How the storage charge is worked out depends on that span:

| Calendar days from the booking date to the currently booked delivery date | Storage charge added to the fee of each owed move |
|---|---|
| 21 or more | Storage by the day: $1.20 for every day beyond the 14th |
| 15 to 20 | A flat storage charge of $10.00, whatever the number of days |
| Fewer than 15 | No storage charge |

Storage by the day is the number of days less 14, multiplied by $1.20. Both dates are read from the appointment: the date it was booked and the delivery date it is booked for now.

## Worked spans (hypothetical appointments)

| Days in the span | Storage charge per owed move |
|---|---|
| 30 | 16 days beyond the 14th at $1.20: $19.20 |
| 25 | 11 days at $1.20: $13.20 |
| 21 | 7 days at $1.20: $8.40 |
| 20 | Flat $10.00 |
| 15 | Flat $10.00 |
| 14 | None |

The charge is added to each owed move's fee: an appointment with two moves owing a fee and a 25-day span carries $13.20 on each of the two moves.
